fundamental_bias.method: Rules-based 30-minute snapshot, refreshed every 30 minutes. Fundamental score uses 24-hour DXY move inverted (40%), WTI move as an inflation-pressure proxy (35%), and up to 25% from keyword-scored news headlines; market returns are capped at +/-2%. If no headline is directionally scored, its weight is omitted and market weights are rescaled. Gold price is separate confirmation. Scores are model outputs, not probabilities or predictions.
